effective_plan.status: Prospective before source edits or timing
effective_plan.scope: General source-closed sole-output elementwise expression DAG with exactly one ordered F64 product. Reuse resident source factories/bounds and maintained Cranelift product scalar/SIMD emission. Optimize optimization15 only; unchanged ports, input shapes/data, C binaries, limits, tolerance, timing/cache boundaries.
physical_work_removed: Product accumulator feeds its original scalar/exact/broadcast arithmetic consumers before the final store.
No product-result or elementwise intermediate payload buffers, initialization, complete write/read passes, canonical Values or separate per-operator prepare/finish boundaries on the admitted path.
Retain a materialized result for later products or other consumers; never recompute a product across downstream reductions.
source_proof: Private nonserialized recipe rederived from exact same-plan selected product/elementwise factories, genuine operands, liveness and same-context straight-line CFG. Bounded nodes/leaves/steps, no activation boundary or outside predecessor.

All external operands must be immutable and available before entry. Total same-schema aliases may be substituted only with complete read-role accounting. Intermediates must be private; the only escaping matrix expression is the final output. Unsupported scalar definitions, branches, extra products, captures or escaping intermediates decline until independently proved.

The final current output must have the admitted product shape. Intermediate elementwise shapes may be scalar/row/column projections of that shape, independently validated by their original factories; shared resident geometry composes leaf projections into the final cell domain. Intermediate node arithmetic and term order remain exactly the Mech source tree, independent of algebraic C equivalence.
implementation: A new paired exact synchronous product-epilogue loan and frame; preserve ordinary NumericBinaryFrame/Pending layout and the frozen scalar root prefix. Pin current original owners; only final output cells allocate. No interpreter, generic per-element operation dispatch or per-operation allocation.

Use existing numeric_product scalar/SIMD ordered +0/k accumulation; add a compile-time epilogue emitter with direct maintained f64_arithmetic instructions and independent output lanes. Ordinary no-epilogue emission remains the accepted form.

Prove/admit complete original factory geometries, shapes, demands, current owners, alias/publication/retirement obligations, skipped source visit fees, all logical work/comparison fees, full coexistence/metadata/node/clone bounds and replay credit before mutation. Overflow or caps decline to the original entry.

Retain intermediate rounding. Any nonfinite intermediate before a consumer cancels the private result and replays the original source, with adequate prepaid admission, no partial publication and no reassociation/FMA. Final nonfinite arithmetic follows the maintained emitted operation; NaN inputs decline.

Finish binds issued frame, pointer/count, exact entry visit epoch/context/source proof, current budget and final output. Interleaved helper/visit and forged images/lanes/loans must reject. A genuine fused transition reports honest physical visits; no padded counters.

Broadcast composition: retain each original intermediate logical shape and factory demand; compute cheap pure elementwise intermediates per final output cell with composed shared resident input projection modes. Never recompute the expensive product. Explicitly admit/charge a checked per-final-cell bound for native epilogue work/comparisons, in addition to every original source obligation.

Only genuine external scalar words use the existing helper argument lane. Managed inputs resolve through the private source proof and current canonical arena. Cache scalar slot/ID mapping at preparation, derive only the scalar capacity floor on image loading, and preserve the fixed corpus transport geometry; no extra managed zero-word transport slots.
required_qualification: Original/decoded source proof, positive scalar/exact/broadcast epilogues and DAGs, negative escapes/extra products/non-dominating leaves/branches/contexts/activation/source mutations. Inspect optimization graphs untimed before runtime implementation if needed.
